events.verdict: Olynyk (UTA) re-establishes himself slightly in Payne's (PHX) path and some contact occurs as Payne goes under the screen.
Payne (PHX) brings his forearm forward towards Clarkson (UTA) and marginal contact occurs on the perimeter.
Olynyk (UTA) is already in Payne's (PHX) path and marginal lower body contact occurs as Payne moves over the pick.
Olynyk (UTA) establishes himself in Payne's (PHX) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Booker (PHX) is moving alongside Markkanen's (UTA) path and marginal contact occurs on the perimeter.
Markkanen (UTA) is bracing for the contact from Booker (PHX), and marginal contact occurs as he releases away from the contact.
Booker (PHX) legally contests Markkanen's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Beasley (UTA) is moving alongside Booker's (PHX) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Beasley (UTA) moves somewhat laterally towards Booker (PHX) and marginal contact occurs prior to Booker's gather.
Beasley (UTA) applies his forearm to Booker's (PHX) side and immediately removes his forearm as Booker begins his upward shooting motion.
Markkanen (UTA) briefly grasps Ayton's (PHX) arm, and he immediately releases Ayton as he pursues the rebound.
After gathering the rebound, Ayton (PHX) leaves his feet to start his dribble.
Olynyk (UTA) legally contests Payne's (PHX) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Ayton (PHX) brings his hands towards Sexton (UTA) and marginal contact occurs as he releases from the contact.
Sexton (UTA) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Bridges (PHX) moves laterally into Clarkson's (UTA) path and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Craig (PHX) commits a take foul on Clarkson (UTA).
Clarkson (UTA) steps slightly forward towards Bridges (PHX) and marginal contact occurs on the perimeter.
Clarkson (UTA) moves somewhat laterally towards Bridges (PHX) and marginal contact occurs on the perimeter.
Bridges (PHX) loses control of the ball on his own during his drive to the basket.
Payne (PHX) fails to establish himself in Sexton's (UTA) path, and he delivers contact as he continues to move forward into Sexton on the perimeter.
Markkanen (UTA) briefly grasps Ayton's (PHX) uniform as they pursue the rebound.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the contact by Olynyk (UTA) occurred after the expiration of the game clock.
